name: linguas-de-gato
description: A personal, local-first language-learning workspace. English first.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names server,client --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @ldg/server" "npm run dev --workspace @ldg/client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @ldg/shared && npm run build --workspace @ldg/server && npm run build --workspace @ldg/client
